texts.en:
We have uncovered a Strategic Resource! Many £strategic_resource£ Strategic Resources require specific technologies to exploit, but can confer powerful bonuses.

To secure a Strategic Resource;

£dot_green£ Select a £construction_ship£ Construction Ship
£dot_green£ Right-click the £system£ System containing the resource
£dot_green£ Select [GetBuildGrowCap] £mining_station£ Mining Stations

Strategic Resources can be used to build advanced £building£ Buildings and Ship components or simply sold.
